decisions.quote: We replicate and extend their analysis by estimating a more complete logit model and comparing it both to a neural network and to a linear discriminant analysis.
decisions.reason: The abstract describes re-analysing Beck, King, and Zeng's (2000) analysis using an expanded logit specification and alternative estimators rather than collecting new sample data, which makes this a reproduction.

decisions.quote: We replicate and extend their analysis by estimating a more complete logit model and comparing it both to a neural network and to a linear discriminant analysis. Our work reveals that neural networks do not perform substantially better than either the logit or the linear discriminant estimators.
decisions.reason: As a reproduction, the alternative model specification and estimator comparisons challenge the original neural-network superiority finding (robustness challenges), whereas the abstract alone cannot establish whether computational recovery of the original numbers was checked in the unseen full text (cannot_be_determined).

parent_objection: Only the abstract and a target citation are supplied. Model re-estimation can occur either on original data or on a different sample. The first reason contrasts this with not collectingnewdata,which risks treating abstract absence as proof. Is there positive source evidence establishing original-data reuse,or must type and dependentaxes remain undeterminable? Do not invent dataset/provenance details or draw on remembered fulltext. A model comparison challenges neuralnetworksuperiority only in the appropriate resolved vocabulary.
